svg.text: #161 · A run can target one step: one Nextflow module, or one Snakemake rule
the run's target, behind the single_target feature flag in 0.0.2 · api 5.10, ui-spec 4.15, spike module-run of 2026-11-10
Nextflow module: one process, outside any pipeline
Snakemake rule: the rule and only the jobs it needs

svg.text: colour never carries the scope alone:
the word is written, and the cells repeat it,
three for a pipeline, one for a module,
the second of two for a rule or a file
7 · both runs land in the runs list, with a Scope badge
grey for a whole pipeline, the violet accent for a module, sky blue for a rule or a file
